items.quote: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
items.claim: Moses' skin emitted a luminous glow when descending from Mount Sinai with the tables of testimony
items.action: descended from mount Sinai / his face shone
